scenarios.name: program
scenarios.note: A program (RFC 0005): what it builds is drawn. A revision on a definition changes the screen, and its undo brings it back to the pixel.

set./program/program.screen.lisp/rooms:
;; The rooms the screen lists. Building reads them; nothing here reads the state.
(def rooms "The rooms shown." [{:id "kitchen" :name "Kitchen"} {:id "hall" :name "Hall"} {:id "attic" :name "Attic"}])
